title: Will not use this vendor again.
text: Will not use this vendor again.. Disappointed.  Very expensive for such a small selection of shells and most not big enough to show through the thick layer of sand.

description: Beautiful 5" dia, Hand blown glass Sand & Shell Globe. Hollow on the inside and half filled with exotic sand and colorful seashells that are free to move when you shake the sphere. Bury the shells, then shake the sphere. Watch the shells float back to the top, creating a new unique beach scene every time. Our hand blown glass is crystal clear, thick and very durable. Made in USA. Patent # 5,187,889
